name: Cell-Projection Rendering
definition: A rendering method where each processor scan-converts its local unstructured cells to produce ray segments, which are then routed to their final destinations in image space for merging. Unlike ray-casting, it does not require pre-sorting cells in depth order.
summary: Cell-projection rendering projects mesh cells into image space to generate ray segments, avoiding depth sorting and offering greater flexibility and accuracy than slice- or vertex-projected methods.
